Work through the guidance with the people who collect and validate your data.On this pageReporting cycleData validationFocal pointsReporting cycleStart by agreeing a reporting timetable and identifying the data needed for each indicator. Keep a record of sources, methods and gaps so the next reporting cycle can build on this work.Data validationCheck that figures use consistent definitions and reporting periods. Agree who collects the evidence, who reviews it and who approves the final submission.Continue with data validation

Work through the guidance with the people who collect and validate your data.On this pageReporting cycleData validationFocal pointsReporting cycleStart by agreeing a reporting timetable and identifying the data needed for each indicator. Keep a record of sources, methods and gaps so the next reporting cycle can build on this work.Data validationCheck that figures use consistent definitions and reporting periods. Discuss unexpected changes with the organizations supplying the data and record the reasons for any revisions.Focal pointsA national focal point coordinates contributions from the institutions involved. Agree who collects the evidence, who reviews it and who approves the final submission.Continue with data validation
